name: OpenAgentEmail Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted agent email and task-handoff platform with SMTP/IMAP mailbox integration, REST/MCP APIs, approval threads and webhooks; no per-identity software license fee or expiry. Default sending rate limit is 20 messages/hour per identity, configurable.
watch_out: Self-hosting does not include a free domain, VPS, mailbox, SMTP relay or outbound delivery. Bundled mailserver needs DNS and reachable mail ports; API-only mode needs an external catch-all mailbox. Ordinary mail defaults to 30-day retention. Secure API tokens and TLS; provider limits and infrastructure costs apply.
